declared.description: The ZekNova runtime root, needed by lineage verification and every live-parity path.
declared.resolution: Explicit ZEKNOVA_ROOT through ZEKNOVA_ROOT_CONTRACT_V1; no default, no search, fail-closed with a named reason.

declared.description: 28 entry points fell back to one developer's Desktop path when the variable was unset, turning a missing dependency into an anonymous ENOENT.
declared.resolution: Default removed everywhere; the binding is now null when unset and the contract decides what happens next.

declared.description: scripts/sentinel-grid-mainline-status.sh and scripts/sentinel-grid-mainline-verify.sh hardcoded absolute Desktop paths for BOTH repositories, so the mainline entry points only ran on one machine.
declared.resolution: The Sentinel root is derived from the script location; the ZekNova root must be declared and is checked before use, with exit 2 and a named reason when it is not.

declared.description: integration/status.mjs defaulted both roots to os.homedir()/Desktop/... — a machine assumption rather than a default, and invisible to a literal-path scan.
declared.resolution: Sentinel derives from the module location; ZekNova comes from --zeknova or ZEKNOVA_ROOT and is never inferred.

declared.description: integration/mainline-integration.json and integration/targets/zeknova.json record the absolute paths of a past install.
declared.resolution: Left unchanged. They are a record of where an install happened, not a source anyone resolves a path from; rewriting them would falsify the record without making anything portable.

declared.description: tests/evidence-portability.test.js uses '/Users/example/project' to assert that absolute paths are NOT encoded into evidence.
declared.resolution: Left unchanged on purpose. Replacing it would delete the assertion it exists to make.

declared.description: A tracked, executable copy of the Stage 2F.4E.3G R8-R4 forensic review script sits at the repository root under a filename consisting of a single space, and builds every path from $HOME/Desktop/... It is a near-duplicate of .tmp-r8-r4/stage2f4e3g-r8-r4-final-review.sh and nothing references it.
declared.resolution: Recorded, not repaired and not deleted. It is on no execution path, so it is not a portability defect of the running system; it is an accidentally committed artifact whose removal is a repository-hygiene decision, not this stage's to make. Named here so it is excluded knowingly rather than missed.

declared.description: .tmp-r8-r3-r2/MANUAL_APPLY.sh carries developer paths from an earlier runtime rebuild.
declared.resolution: Not on any execution path and excluded from the production bundle. Left as historical scratch.

declared.description: Sentinel roots are derived from import.meta.dirname rather than hardcoded.
declared.resolution: Already portable; relative to the module, so the repository can live anywhere.

declared.description: Tests that need scratch space use os.tmpdir() rather than a fixed directory.
